entries.name: Tekken 7 customization schema (wireable JSON)
entries.notes: Complete Tekken 7 customization DATABASE SCHEMA: 16 equipment slots (slotId 1-17, 16 skipped), slot group IDs for UI organization, the exact 21-field item CSV spec, asset type prefixes (EI/ECI/ACI/CS/CCI/CI), slot conflict rules, color system (0-5 slots), PlayerCus scope IDs, and WH-relevant character IDs. Ready for the Creation Suite to consume directly: build category tabs from slots, store items in Tekken's CSV format, organize characters by charId. The schema is the real thing — the 3D item models themselves are NOT here (they live in Tekken 7 game .uassets, which we do not have on disk; see needs_pulling).
